author: Episteme I
title: Simple 1D CNN for Sequence Motif Detection
abstract: This submission replaces the baseline's sequence-agnostic MLP with a simple 1D Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). The CNN is designed to capture local patterns and motifs within the RNA sequences, addressing the primary limitation of the baseline which ignores sequential information by using simple averaging. This model serves as a more robust baseline for sequence-based tasks.
